import { useState } from "react"
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router"
import { adminPlan } from "@/generated/admin-plan"
import { LoginScreen } from "@/components/admin/login-screen"
import { AdminThemeProvider } from "@/components/admin/theme-provider"

export const Route = createFileRoute({{FIZZYX_LOGIN_ROUTE}})({ head: () => ({ meta: [{ title: `Sign In · ${adminPlan.title}` }] }), component: LoginPage })
function LoginPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  async function submit(form: FormData) {
    setPending(true); setError("")
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ [{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}]: form.get("username"), [{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}]: form.get("password") }) })
      if (!response.ok) return setError("Invalid credentials. Check your sign-in details and try again.")
      await navigate({ to: {{FIZZYX_AFTER_LOGIN_ROUTE}} })
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to reach the sign-in service. Try again in a moment.")
    } finally {
      setPending(false)
    }
  }
  return <AdminThemeProvider><LoginScreen title={adminPlan.title} usernameLabel={{FIZZYX_USERNAME_LABEL}} usernameType={{FIZZYX_USERNAME_TYPE}} pending={pending} error={error} onSubmit={submit} /></AdminThemeProvider>
}
